leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a generic Command interface to enforce type safety across different commands
Construct a CommandBus class with typed methods for registering and executing commands
Configure command handlers that process specific command types and return typed results
Initialize and instantiate the CommandBus with registered handlers for different command types
Manipulate the command execution flow by adding middleware for cross-cutting concerns
Apply the typed command bus to dispatch commands and handle results in a sample application
Integrate error handling within the command bus to manage execution failures gracefully
